change.description: The +k8s:member comment tag is added to the Replicas field of StatefulSetSpec. Like all +k8s: comment tags, it is a code-generator annotation consumed exclusively by validation-gen at generation time. The Go compiler does not parse or validate these comment tags — they are invisible to it and have no effect on compilation. The downstream effect (updated zz_generated.validations.go for apps/v1) only materialises when hack/update-codegen.sh is re-run, and those regenerated files are explicitly excluded by the question. No manually-edited file requires any change as a result of adding this comment tag.
